introduce:
Start in the push-up position, but keep your arms straight. 

Keep your body straight and hold this position as long as you can. 

Don't hold your breath. Breathe normally from your abdomen instead of your chest.

This exercise strengthens your abdomen and back muscles.
name: STRAIGHT-ARM PLANK

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Put your hands directly underneath your shoulders.
Tighten your core and gluteus.
Do not sink your lower back or raise your hips in the air.
Breathe deeply.
Too easy for you? Add weight on your lower back.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This exercise really works on your core and lower back.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Then take a breath in and make your belly fall down, shoulders roll back and head come up towards the ceiling. 

As you exhale, round your spine toward the ceiling and draw your navel up towards your spine, and drop your head.

Repeat the exercise, matching the movement to your breath.
name: CAT COW POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your palms are directly under your shoulders.
Please make sure your knees are directly under your hips.
Inhale as your belly falls down, and exhale as your belly curves in.
This exercise works on your spine, back and abs.

introduce: Stand with your thighs together. Inhale as you raise your arms overhead. Exhale as you bend your knees and sink back, coming into a seated position.\n\nLean your torso forward slightly to balance. Breathe slowly and deeply through your nose without holding your breath as you hold this posture. With each exhale, release and sink a little deeper.
name: CHAIR

tips.text: Please don’t let your knees go over your toes.
Please put your weight on your heels.
This exercise is beneficial to your arms, legs and cardiovascular system.
Inhale to expand the chest. Exhale to engage the core and press into the heels.

introduce:
Start on hands and knees. Put your knees and toes together.

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, sit your hips back to your heels, arms reaching forward. Rest your forehead, soften your elbows, and lower your chest close to the floor.

Breathe slowly through your nose; with each exhale, release and sink a little deeper.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Inhale to allow your belly to expand into your thighs. Exhale to soften into the pose.

introduce:
Stand on the floor with your feet together. 

Then bend your body and bring your upper body as close to your legs as you can. 

Hold this position for a few seconds and repeat.

Exhale when you bend your body and inhale when you come up. Keep your legs straight during the exercise.
name: FORWARD BEND

tips.text: Please keep your legs straight.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Start with your hands rested on your hips and your feet shoulder width apart. 

Tilt your head towards your left shoulder and then to the right. 

Don’t move your shoulders when you tilt your head.
name: HEAD TILT

tips.text: Please don\'t move your shoulders when tilting your head.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Lie on the floor with your feet together. Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together. Let your knees fall comfortably out to the sides, moving them toward the floor. \n\nPlace your hands by your sides or on your belly, and begin to breathe slowly and deeply through your nose. Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to allow your knees to sink closer to the floor.
name: LYING BUTTERFLY STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
You should feel a stretch in your groin.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your knees down.
Try to let your knees get closer and closer to the floor.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Inhale, lift your left arm overhead, and put your right hand on the floor for support. Exhale slowly, bend your upper body to the right, gently bending your right arm. 

Hold the side bend. Breathe deeply into your left rib cage to help deepen the stretch.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your body.
Inhale to expand through the ribs, exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Inhale, lift your right arm overhead, and put your left hand on the floor for support. Exhale slowly, bend your upper body to the left, gently bending your left arm. 

Hold the side bend. Breathe deeply into your right rib cage to help deepen the stretch.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your body.
Inhale to expand through the ribs, exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce:
Lie down on your back with your legs extended. Relax your spine and gently press your lower back into the floor. 

Inhale, lift your knees toward your chest. Exhale, hug your knees gently.

Hold the position without holding your breath. Inhale as you lengthen your spine. Exhale as you soften your shoulders and hips.
name: DOUBLE KNEES TO CHEST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Hold on your thighs instead if you have knee injuries.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your lower back muscles.
It helps to restore flexibility to your lower back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your shoulders and hips.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, chest up and shoulders back. Exhale, lift one knee up, and grab it with both hands.\n\nThen gently pull it towards your body as much as you can. Breathe naturally. Hold for a few seconds, switch sides and repeat.
name: STANDING KNEE TO CHEST

tips.text: Please keep your body straight when lifting your knee up.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Sit cross-legged with your right leg in and extend your left leg in front of you.

Inhale, then exhale as you fold your upper body forward. Try to grasp your left foot with both hands.

Hold this position. Inhale to grow taller through your spine, exhale to relax your shoulders and deepen the stretch along your left hamstring.
name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your left thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your left thigh.

introduce:
Sit cross-legged with your left leg in and extend your right leg in front of you.

Inhale, then exhale as you fold your upper body forward. Try to grasp your right foot with both hands.

Hold this position. Inhale to grow taller through your spine, exhale to relax your shoulders and deepen the stretch along your right hamstring.
name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your right thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your right thigh.

introduce: Lie flat on your back with legs extended wider than hip-width apart, arms relaxed by your sides, palms up. \n\nInhale slowly through your nose, your spine gently lengthening and your body becoming light. Exhale fully, allowing your shoulders, hips, and entire body to melt into the mat, and consciously relax any areas of tightness or tension throughout your body.
name: RELAXATION LYING POSE

tips.text: Close your eyes, relax your arms and legs, relax your face, relax the ankles.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to release tension of your body.
Let any weight, any tension relax to the earth, feel the floor below you, supporting you.
Let every part of your body relax and lower to the ground.
Invite rest and peace into your mind, body and soul.

introduce:
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.

Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale, shift weight to the right foot, and press the left sole on your inner calf or thigh. Bring your hands to a prayer position at your chest. 

Hold this position with steady breath. With each exhale, relax your shoulders and press your left knee open.
name: TREE POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep looking ahead.
Extend your spine.
Press your foot against your inner thigh.
Don\'t press your foot on knee joint of standing leg.
Engage your abs to maintain balance instead of ankle.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to press your left knee open.
If too easy for you, extend your arms overhead, and keep your elbows straight.
If too hard for you, lower heel to your calf or ankle.
Your neck and shoulders should not feel tense.
This is a good exercise for your core and your lower body.

introduce:
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.

Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale, shift weight to the left foot, and press the right sole on your inner calf or thigh. Bring your hands to a prayer position at your chest. 

Hold this position with steady breath. With each exhale, relax your shoulders and press your right knee open.
name: TREE POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep looking ahead.
Extend your spine.
Press your foot against your inner thigh.
Don\'t press your foot on knee joint of standing leg.
Engage your abs to maintain balance instead of ankle.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to press your right knee open.
If too easy for you, extend your arms overhead, and keep your elbows straight.
If too hard for you, lower heel to your calf or ankle.
Your neck and shoulders should not feel tense.
This is a good exercise for your core and your lower body.

introduce:
Sit with the soles of your feet together. Draw your heels towards your hips, and press your knees down as much as possible. 

Place your hands in front of you, lean forward and lower your upper body as close to the ground as possible. Hold this position. 

Each time you exhale, try harder to reach for the floor with your body.

Please note
You may need to practice several times to perfect your form.
name: BUTTERFLY POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Press your knees down as much as possible.
Breathe deeply.
Keep your sit bones down.
You should feel the stretch in your thighs.
This position can open up your hips and thighs.
This position helps stretch your thighs.

introduce:
Sit upright on the floor. Bend your left leg with your heel close to your sit bone. Extend your right leg forward. Put your left hand on the floor behind you for support. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, twist your upper body to the left. Bend your right elbow and hook it on the outside of your left knee, fingers pointing upward. Turn your gaze over your left shoulder.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine. With each exhale, gently rotate your body deeper into the twist.
name: SAGE MARICHI'S POSE Ⅲ LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your legs still when twisting your body.
Twist from your waist instead of your chest.
Evenly distribute your weight between both sit bones.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist.
If sitting upright is challenging, place a block under your buttocks.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, chest, and spine.
This exercise helps relieve your back and hip pain.

introduce:
Sit upright on the floor. Bend your right leg with your heel close to your sit bone. Extend your left leg forward. Put your right hand on the floor behind you for support. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, twist your upper body to the right. Bend your left elbow and hook it on the outside of your right knee, fingers pointing upward. Turn your gaze over your right shoulder.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine. With each exhale, gently rotate your body deeper into the twist.
name: SAGE MARICHI'S POSE Ⅲ RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your legs still when twisting your body.
Twist from your waist instead of your chest.
Evenly distribute your weight between both sit bones.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist.
If sitting upright is challenging, place a block under your buttocks.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, chest, and spine.
This exercise helps relieve your back and hip pain.

introduce:
Stand with your feet hip-width apart, draw your belly in, and roll your shoulders back and down.

Inhale and raise your arms overhead and lengthen your spine. Exhale and hinge forward from your hips, keeping your spine long. Place your hands on your shins.

Hold the position with slow, deep breaths through your nose. Inhale to extend the spine, exhale to relax and release deeper into the fold.
name: HALF FORWARD BEND

tips.text: Bend from your hips instead of your waist.
Keep your legs straight but don\'t lock your knees.
Focus on keeping your back flat and lengthening your spine.
Inhale to extend the spine, exhale to release deeper into the fold.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.
This exercise strengthens your back.

introduce:
Stand upright with your arms by your sides. Interlock your fingers and turn your palms upward. 

Inhale as you raise your arms overhead and lift your heels. Balance on your toes and lengthen through your whole body. Hold the pose with slow, steady breaths. Feel your shoulders relax and your shoulder blades sink. 

Exhale, lower your heels and arms back to the starting position.
name: PALM TREE POSE

tips.text: Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your back straight.
This exercise stretches your entire body and improves your balance.
Inhale to stretch up, exhale to lower back.

introduce:
Lay prone with your hands under your shoulders and the tops of your feet on the floor. 

Inhale as you press through your hands firmly into the floor. Straighten your arms and lift your chest. Slightly lift your thighs off the ground. Gaze forward or slightly upward.

Hold the position with deep and steady breath. Inhale to expand your chest and lengthen your spine, exhale to soften your shoulders, relax your neck, and keep your arms and core stable.
name: UPWARD FACING DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Rotate your shoulders back and down.
Keep your legs engaged, don\'t slouch them on the floor.
Keep your neck natural, don\'t strain your neck.
This exercise stretches your chest, abdomen, and spine.
This exercise can firm your buttocks and thighs.
Inhale to lift your chest. Exhale to soften your shoulders.

introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned outward. 

Inhale, bring your hands together into a prayer position at your chest. Exhale, bend your knees and lower your hips as much as possible. Press your elbows against your inner knees to open up your hips. 

Keep your heels on the floor; if needed, place a rolled-up towel under them.

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to relax your hips and deepen the stretch.
name: GARLAND POSE

tips.text: Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your hips and deepen the stretch.
This exercise stretches your groins, lower back, and hips.
This exercise strengthens and stretches your ankles.

introduce:
Start on all fours. Spread your fingers wide for stability. On an inhale, lift your hips to form an inverted V-shape. Try to keep a soft bend in your knees and press your heels on the floor.

On an inhale, press firmly through your hands. Exhale, lift your left leg straight back in line with your spine without twisting your hips.

Inhale, shift forward into plank, shoulders over wrists, and draw your knee toward your left elbow.

Return and repeat the exercise.
name: DOWNWARD FACING DOG WITH KNEE DRIVES LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Exhale to lift your leg straight back. Inhale to shift forward into plank.
This exercise stretches your full body and helps build your strength.

introduce:
Start on all fours. Spread your fingers wide for stability. On an inhale, lift your hips to form an inverted V-shape. Try to keep a soft bend in your knees and press your heels on the floor.

On an inhale, press firmly through your hands. Exhale, lift your right leg straight back in line with your spine without twisting your hips.

Inhale, shift forward into plank, shoulders over wrists, and draw your knee toward your right elbow.

Return and repeat the exercise.
name: DOWNWARD FACING DOG WITH KNEE DRIVES RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Exhale to lift your leg straight back. Inhale to shift forward into plank.
This exercise stretches your full body and helps build your strength.

introduce: Start on all fours. Exhale as you lift your hips into an inverted ‘V’ shape, and lengthen your spine.\n\nAlternately lift and lower your heels with steady breath.
name: WALK THE DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Relax your neck.
Keep a steady and even breathing rhythm without holding your breath.
Notice the elongation from your fingertips to your sit bone.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Please press all areas of the palms equally on the floor.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, hamstrings, calves, and arches.

introduce:
Start in a low lunge with your left foot forward and right knee on the floor. 

Inhale, and reach your arms overhead. Exhale, tuck your pelvis, and glide your hips forward and down. Draw your lower belly in, and avoid collapsing your lower back. 

Hold this position with deep breaths. Inhale to extend your spine, exhale to sink your body deeper.
name: CRESCENT LOW LUNGE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don\'t let your front knee go over your toes.
This exercise stretches your hips, chest, and belly.
This exercise strengthens your thighs and shoulders.
Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to relax your hips and shoulders.

introduce:
Start in a push-up position. 

Inhale, step your left foot forward inside your left hand, and lower your right knee to the floor, then exhale. Inhale, lengthen through the spine. Exhale, rotate your upper body to the left and reach your left arm to the sky. Look at your left hand. 

Hold this position. Inhale to extend your spine, exhale to open your chest and hips.
name: CRESCENT LOW LUNGE WITH ARM EXTENDED UP LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
If your neck strains, you can keep your gaze neutral.
This exercise opens your shoulders and hips.
This exercise stretches your chest and glutes.
This exercise helps tone your deltoids.
Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to open your chest and hips.

introduce:
Start in a push-up position. 

Inhale, step your right foot forward inside your right hand, and lower your left knee to the floor, then exhale. Inhale, lengthen through the spine. Exhale, rotate your upper body to the right and reach your right arm to the sky. Look at your right hand. 

Hold this position. Inhale to extend your spine, exhale to open your chest and hips.
name: CRESCENT LOW LUNGE WITH ARM EXTENDED UP RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
If your neck strains, you can keep your gaze neutral.
This exercise opens your shoulders and hips.
This exercise stretches your chest and glutes.
This exercise helps tone your deltoids.
Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to open your chest and hips.

introduce:
Lie on your back and inhale. Exhale to draw your knees toward your chest, separate the knees, and raise the feet so the soles of the feet are toward the ceiling.

Inhale, grab the inside of your feet. Exhale, gently sink the shoulders and tailbone toward the floor.

Hold the position. Inhale to lengthen the spine, exhale to soften your hips and lower back into the mat.
name: HAPPY BABY POSE

tips.text: Please do this on the mat.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to soften your hips and lower back.
Keep your head on the mat to avoid neck strain.
This exercise can help relieve your lower back pain.
This exercise stretches your inner thighs, hamstrings, groin, and spine.

introduce:
Stand with your feet wide apart. Turn your left foot out and your right foot slightly in.

Exhale as you bend your left knee until your thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Inhale as you raise your arms out to the sides at shoulder height. 

Exhale, bend your body forward and lower your left arm so your forearm rests on your left thigh. Extend your right arm overhead in line with your torso. Look up at the ceiling.

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to relax and deepen the side stretch.
name: EXTENDED SIDE ANGLE LEFT

tips.text: Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Don\'t let your knee go over your toes.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
Put your weight mainly on your legs instead of your elbow.
This exercise strengthens your shoulders, thighs, and glutes.
This exercise stretches your groins, hamstrings, waist, and shoulders.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce:
Stand with your feet wide apart. Turn your right foot out and your left foot slightly in.

Exhale as you bend your right knee until your thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Inhale as you raise your arms out to the sides at shoulder height. 

Exhale, bend your body forward and lower your right arm so your forearm rests on your right thigh. Extend your left arm overhead in line with your torso. Look up at the ceiling.

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to relax and deepen the side stretch.
name: EXTENDED SIDE ANGLE RIGHT

tips.text: Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Don't let your knee go over your toes.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
Put your weight mainly on your legs instead of your elbow.
This exercise strengthens your shoulders, thighs, and glutes.
This exercise stretches your groins, hamstrings, waist, and shoulders.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce:
Stand with feet hip-width apart. Take a deep inhale and step your left foot forward while turning the right foot out about 60 degrees.

Exhale as you lower your body until your left thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Inhale as you raise your arms overhead, palms facing each other.

Hold the position with slow, deep breaths. Inhale to lengthen your spine and lift your chest, exhale to engage your core, and stay stable.
name: WARRIOR Ⅰ LEFT

tips.text: Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don\'t let your front knee go over your toes.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
This exercise strengthens your thighs, shoulders, and back.
This exercise stretches your chest, hips, and legs.
Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to engage your core.

introduce:
Stand with feet hip-width apart. Take a deep inhale and step your right foot forward while turning the left foot out about 60 degrees.

Exhale as you lower your body until your right thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Inhale as you raise your arms overhead, palms facing each other.

Hold the position with slow, deep breaths. Inhale to lengthen your spine and lift your chest, exhale to engage your core, and stay stable.
name: WARRIOR Ⅰ RIGHT

tips.text: Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don't let your front knee go over your toes.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
This exercise strengthens your thighs, shoulders, and back.
This exercise stretches your chest, hips, and legs.
Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to engage your core.

introduce:
Stand tall with your feet together. Take a big step back with your right leg, toes pointing slightly in. Bend your left knee until your left thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Raise your arms to the sides, palms down.

Inhale, lift your left arm overhead for a big stretch along your side. At the same time, lower your right hand and slide it down your right leg. Exhale, draw your belly in and tuck your tailbone to stabilize your core. Take your gaze to your left hand.

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, and exhale to relax your side body.
name: REVERSE WARRIOR LEFT

tips.text: Keep your bent knee in line with your toes.
Don\'t put any weight on your back hand.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Don\'t let your bent knee go over your toes.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Engage your core.
This exercise strengthens your thighs and improves your core strength and balance.
This exercise stretches your hips, groins, obliques, and hamstrings.
This exercise releases tension in your muscles around the ribs.
Inhale to strengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your side body.

introduce:
Stand tall with your feet together. Take a big step back with your left leg, toes pointing slightly in. Bend your right knee until your right thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Raise your arms to the sides, palms down.

Inhale, lift your right arm overhead for a big stretch along your side. At the same time, lower your left hand and slide it down your left leg. Exhale, draw your belly in and tuck your tailbone to stabilize your core. Take your gaze to your right hand.

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, and exhale to relax your side body.
name: REVERSE WARRIOR RIGHT

tips.text: Keep your bent knee in line with your toes.
Don’t put any weight on your back hand.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Don’t let your bent knee go over your toes.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Engage your core.

This exercise stretches your hips, groins, obliques, and hamstrings.
This exercise releases tension in your muscles around the ribs.
Inhale to strengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your side body.

Start in a low lunge with your right foot forward and left knee on the floor. 

Inhale, and reach your arms overhead. Exhale, tuck your pelvis, and glide your hips forward and down. Draw your lower belly in, and avoid collapsing your lower back. 

Hold this position with deep breaths. Inhale to extend your spine, exhale to sink your body deeper.
name: CRESCENT LOW LUNGE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don't let your front knee go over your toes.
This exercise stretches your hips, chest, and belly.
This exercise strengthens your thighs and shoulders.
Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to relax your hips and shoulders.

introduce:
Lie down on your stomach and bend your elbows with your hands beneath your shoulders.

Keep your toes back and your feet and legs relaxed on the ground.

Exhale, push your chest up off the ground as far as possible. As you inhale, return to the start position and repeat.
name: COBRAS

tips.text: Prepare a mat first.
Tighten your abdominals.
Stretch your abdominals as much as you can.
Inhale when you go up, and exhale when you go down.
This is a great exercise to strengthen your back.
